title: 0.9.2 Release Signing Policy (frozen)
note: Private keys and key material are NEVER included in this policy or any repository artifact. This policy defines the mechanism, identity binding, and verification contract only.

source_archive.signing_mechanism: GPG detached signature over the archive's SHA-256 checksum file (SHA256SUMS.asc), repository-configured GPG signing key
source_archive.identity_issuer: Fail-closed until the release process publishes and independently authenticates the full release-key fingerprint; see docs/guides/GPG_KEY_MANAGEMENT.md
source_archive.digest_binding: SHA256SUMS lists the source archive path and its sha256 digest; the detached signature covers the exact checksum file bytes

dynamic_module.signing_mechanism: GPG detached signature over the archive checksum file (SHA256SUMS.asc), using the repository release-signing key
dynamic_module.identity_issuer: Fail-closed until the release process publishes and independently authenticates the full release-key fingerprint; see docs/guides/GPG_KEY_MANAGEMENT.md
dynamic_module.digest_binding: SHA256SUMS lists every published dynamic-module archive and its sha256 digest; the detached signature covers the exact checksum file bytes

deb.signing_mechanism: GPG (dpkg-sig builder signature) using the repository signing key
deb.identity_issuer: Fail-closed until the release process publishes and independently authenticates the full release-key fingerprint; see docs/guides/GPG_KEY_MANAGEMENT.md
deb.digest_binding: The .deb control and payload digests are covered by the embedded dpkg-sig signature; package sha256 also listed in SHA256SUMS
deb.release_pipeline: canonical 0.9.2 release-packages.yml integrity-signing step signs .deb artifacts with dpkg-sig before integrity-checksums generates SHA256SUMS; integrity-signature then signs SHA256SUMS.asc

rpm.signing_mechanism: GPG (rpm --addsign) using the repository signing key
rpm.identity_issuer: Fail-closed until the release process publishes and independently authenticates the full release-key fingerprint; see docs/guides/GPG_KEY_MANAGEMENT.md
rpm.digest_binding: RPM header signature covers package content digest; package sha256 also listed in SHA256SUMS
rpm.release_pipeline: canonical 0.9.2 release-packages.yml integrity-signing step signs .rpm artifacts with rpm --addsign before integrity-checksums generates SHA256SUMS; integrity-signature then signs SHA256SUMS.asc

oci.signing_mechanism: Not enabled for the 0.9.2 artifact channel; no OCI publication workflow is wired
oci.identity_issuer: Not applicable until an OCI workflow and its immutable identity binding are published
oci.attachment_name: Not applicable; no OCI signature is published
oci.digest_binding: Not applicable; no OCI artifact or image digest is published
oci.release_pipeline: Not part of the 0.9.2 release channel

homebrew_formula_source.signing_mechanism: Checksum + provenance verification (no detached GPG required per Requirement 14 criterion 4)
homebrew_formula_source.identity_issuer: Source archive digest computed at formula render time (shasum -a 256 over the tag archive)
homebrew_formula_source.digest_binding: Formula sha256 MUST equal the digest of the exact bytes served by the formula URL (verified by packaging/scripts/verify_homebrew_formula.py and verify_git_archive.py)

homebrew_bottle.signing_mechanism: Checksum + provenance (bottle sha256 recorded in the bottle JSON); no detached GPG
homebrew_bottle.identity_issuer: Bottle digest computed by Homebrew build
homebrew_bottle.attachment_name: Bottle sha256 in the formula/bottle JSON
homebrew_bottle.digest_binding: Bottle sha256 binds the exact bottle artifact bytes
homebrew_bottle.release_pipeline: Homebrew bottle production (when applicable); bottle sha256 embedded in formula JSON

key_management.secret_storage: GitHub Actions environment 'release-signing' secrets (GPG_PRIVATE_KEY, GPG_PASSPHRASE, GPG_KEY_ID); job-scoped to a dedicated signing job, injected only into the signing step and never exposed to build or test steps
key_management.rotation: Key rotation follows docs/guides/GPG_KEY_MANAGEMENT.md; rotated keys remain valid for verification of prior releases

policy_reference_notes: Requirement 14 criterion 4: GPG for source/DEB/RPM after the pinned-key trust anchor is published; OCI signatures are a future Cosign/Sigstore requirement; checksum/provenance covers Homebrew without detached GPG
The release workflow is the sole producer of candidate-bound signatures for the frozen candidate SHA; failed or superseded attempts retain unique run_id and are never promoted
